# PermitIQ by Aureon

PermitIQ by Aureon is an AI-powered NYC building code compliance checker designed for Registered Architects, Professional Engineers, Expediters, and Developers.

## Key Features
- Verifies architectural plans against 112+ NYC Building Code requirements.
- Automatically checks for DOB (Department of Buildings) violations.
- Evaluates zoning compliance, fire safety, egress, mechanical, electrical, and structural codes.
- Generates detailed PDF compliance reports to assist with DOB NOW submissions.

## Important Links
- Home: https://nyccodes.permitiq.live

- Pricing: https://nyccodes.permitiq.live/pricing
- Blog: https://nyccodes.permitiq.live/blog
- Use Cases: https://nyccodes.permitiq.live/use-cases

## Target Audience
Architects, Engineers, Developers, and Expediters working in the 5 boroughs of New York City (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island).
